import gzip, collections
for fn in ['deleterious.mutation.q1.R1.fq.gz','deleterious.mutation.q1.R2.fq.gz']:
    n=0; lengths=collections.Counter(); names=[]
    with gzip.open(fn,'rt') as f:
        while True:
            h=f.readline()
            if not h: break
            s=f.readline().strip(); plus=f.readline(); q=f.readline().strip()
            n+=1; lengths[len(s)]+=1
            if len(names)<3:names.append(h.strip())
    print(fn,n,lengths,names)
PY"
